body.name: Full oracle regime-MAG signature
body.construction: \(\mathcal O(\eta)=\bigl(\operatorname{skel}(M_k(\eta)),\operatorname{UC}(M_k(\eta))\bigr)_{k=0}^{K}\), with both operators evaluated on all of \(U_k\). The \(k=0\) conditional-independence input is the observational selected law \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}=\mathcal L_{\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1)\) on \(U_0=V\), with no \(k\)-indexed indicator. For each \(k\in[K]\), the input is the pooled selected law \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\) on \(X\cup\{\zeta_k\}\), whose arms are \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}\) and \(P_{\eta}^{(k)}\). Thus the signature includes every adjacency \(\zeta_k-v\) and every unshielded collider whose triple contains \(\zeta_k\), as well as every adjacency and unshielded collider entirely within \(V\).
